EmailTemplate.description: This Email template is sent to customers during the account onboarding process to request required KYC documentation. This template informs customers they need to complete the KYC form and visit the service center with their CPR, passport, and proof of address to proceed with their account opening.
EmailTemplate.name: Onboarding_eKey_Document_Required_for_Acc _Required _for_Account_Opening
EmailTemplate.subject: Documents Required to Finalize Your ila Bank Account
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Documents Required for Account Opening Dear Valued Customer,
Greetings from ila Bank — we hope this message finds you well.
We are reaching out to inform you that, in order to proceed with your account opening with us you are required to provide the required documents.
We kindly request that you complete the attached Customer Update Form (KYC) and visit our service center with the below documents:
• Completed Know Your Customer (KYC) form (attached) • Valid ID card (CPR) • A valid passport copy • Proof of address
We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to assisting you. We cannot wait for you to part of the ila family.
If you need any assistance, please call us on +973 17123456 or email us on support@ilabank.com
